description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationService class, responsible for managing reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, including CRUD operations and data normalization.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class providing operations for reporting methods management, including CRUD, searching, counting, and normalization.

methods.name: getReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO instance for reporting methods, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the DAO instance for reporting methods.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting method by its ID.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a reporting method by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Fetches a list of reporting methods based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Counts reporting methods matching specific search filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of reporting methods currently in use.

methods.name: getReportingMethodArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of reporting methods based on search filters.
